arguments.query: What did we decide about the canary rollout?
What was the final decision after the 18:15 UTC canary rollout review in eng-releases?

ben open PR and link here, matt resume canary and watch, ashley push RN and customer notification, kira coordinate account ops, legal signoff included. reconvene at 18:15 UTC to decide on wider rollout

data.text:
We approved a controlled canary for v2.9.3: 10% traffic in us-west-2 for internal and beta users, with a 45-minute watch and automatic rollback if errors exceed 0.5% or policy is breached. Global rollout stays blocked until PR #4821 merges and passes CI and verification. [60af03]

The thread says the team would reconvene at 18:15 UTC to decide on widening rollout, but it doesn’t record that follow-up decision. [60af03]
